title: Relative Sort Array
description: Sort elements of arr1 such that the relative order of elements in arr1 follows the order in arr2. Remaining elements are placed at the end in ascending order.

steps.note: Append all 2s from arr1 to result: [2, 2, 2]
Append all 1s from arr1 to result: [2, 2, 2, 1]
